contexts.text: Two Hebrew men disputing () = that within the Church they fought with each other.
Sensuous men... reason and dispute about everything, as to whether it is so; and these disputes in the Hells are heard outside like gnashings of teeth.
They are shut up in their workhouses, where they vehemently dispute with each other.
(When the Spirit waved his torch) there entered the lust of disputing and quarrelling.
